environment.description: Same FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate in private subnet (no IGW route). ALB is internal-only (scheme: internal). The ALB security group ingress is restricted via a prefix list (pl-0a8f2e19c7d4b3601) that resolves to 10.200.0.0/16 and 10.201.0.0/16 — these are the VPC CIDR ranges allocated exclusively to the BFF (backend-for-frontend) gateway service and the internal admin console. The BFF gateway performs user-ownership validation before proxying requests (verified via integration tests in CI). Additionally, VPC flow logs are enabled and a Network Firewall stateful rule group denies any traffic not matching the prefix list on the internal ALB listener. There is no VPC peering, Transit Gateway attachment, or VPN connection that would allow other CIDR ranges to reach this subnet.

config.network_firewall_stateful_rule: deny all except src in [10.200.0.0/16, 10.201.0.0/16] to dst port 443
config.upstream_bff_authorization: user_id ownership check enforced before proxy
